content:
jia: Evening folks — planning a night-drop for py/ts SDKs in the quiet window (00:30-02:00 UTC). Quick sanity checklist: credentials rotate, dist-tag set, and a short rollback ready. Can someone confirm deploy-bot will use the emergency-disttag if publish fails?

matt: I can monitor the night shift. +1 on backup dist-tag.

deploy-bot: automated check: CI green on main, smoke tests 14/14 passed, artifact signing OK. Ready to publish.

alex: Which dist-tags are we using? current plan was `beta-nightdrop` and fallback `beta-rollback`. Confirming pin policy for types package?

sarah: Deprecation note: removing legacy sync client in next major, include short migration snippet in release notes. Olivia, can docs team add a one-paragraph migration note?

olivia: Yep — I'll add a migration snippet and link to the deprecation FAQ. ETA 30m.

jia: Command I'll run once we start (copying for audit):

```
# publish script (dry-run then actual)
./scripts/publish-sdk.sh --packages py,ts --disttag beta-nightdrop --dry-run
# if successful
./scripts/publish-sdk.sh --packages py,ts --disttag beta-nightdrop --sign
```

jia: Rollback plan if publish produces 500s or type regressions:
- Immediately tag `beta-nightdrop` -> `beta-rollback` (manual dist-tag move)
- Revert npm/pypi release via yank/purge process and re-publish last stable 
- Notify integrators with short note and open a postmortem if >30m outage

matt: For verification, I'll run quick end-to-end smoke after sign: `python -m sdk_smoke --endpoint staging --key $NIGHTKEY` and a TS import test `yarn test:import`.

deploy-bot: publish preview: artifacts staged at s3://redwood-nightdrop/1714012345/ (py wheel, ts tarball). Checksums: ok.

ajia: (typo) meant jia: If anything fails, ping #eng-oncall immediately and I will cut the rollback tag.

alex: One more: please ensure the token used is ephemeral and rotated after publish. I left a short secret rotation snippet in the runbook.

sarah: Also add a line to the release notes about the sync-client deprecation and link to migration guide. Olivia to include snippet.

olivia: Added the snippet in the draft release notes, pushed to `docs/release/drafts/nightdrop-1714012345.md` — waiting on final versions.

matt: I'll be monitoring; will call timeout at 01:15 UTC for a forced rollback if any high-sev test fails.

jia: Thanks all — starting dry-run in ~10m. I'll post back the publish link and the dist-tag move when live. :thumbsup:

(automated followups would be separate messages from deploy-bot with timestamps — left out here for brevity)
